blocks.label: Questions
blocks.title: Building on your land: common questions
items: Can you build on land I already own?

Yes. We build custom homes on our clients' land and handle permits, planning and construction from start to finish. Send us your land's details and we'll look at water, sewer, slope and access with you up front.
Can I bring my own plan?
Yes. You can start from one of our proven plans or bring your own, and we'll fit it to your lot. We regularly customize layouts, finishes and outdoor spaces.
Where do you build?
Throughout North Metro Atlanta and North Georgia, including Cherokee, Bartow, Gordon, Whitfield, Cobb and Pickens counties. If you're not sure your lot is in our area, call us at 706-514-6637.
What comes standard?
Every Riverstone home includes LVP flooring in the main living areas, granite or quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, tiled baths and more. See the full Standard Features list.
How do I pick my finishes?
After your plan is set, we walk you through your selections, from exterior colors and stone to cabinets, flooring and fixtures, with clear deadlines so construction stays on schedule.
I don't have land yet. Where do I start?

Start with Sandra Watkins, our New Home Guide with RE/MAX Town & Country. She specializes in lots and new construction, and you can search land for sale right here by county. Call or text her at 770-324-3680.

blocks.label: Custom homes
blocks.title: A custom home builder for North Georgia.
blocks.lede: Your plan or ours, on your land or ours. One local team has been building custom homes across North Georgia since 1997, and we'll take yours from the first sketch to the keys.

blocks.label: Why build custom
blocks.title: Built around your land and how you live.
paras: A spec home makes you live with someone else's choices. A custom home starts with yours: the lot, the layout, how many bedrooms you really need, where the coffee goes in the morning, and how big the porch should be for a Georgia summer.

As a custom home builder in North Georgia, we know the ground you're building on. Red clay, sloped lots, wells and septic, and six different counties' permit offices all have their quirks, and after building here since 1997 we've learned them so you don't have to.

You'll work with the same three people the whole way: Jamey Cagle, who founded Riverstone and still walks lots, John O'Donnell, our project manager with more than 30 years on job sites, and Sandra Watkins, your New Home Guide.

paras: A pretty lot can hide an expensive surprise: a long driveway, a well and septic you didn't plan for, or a slope that needs a basement. That's why we look at the land with you before you sign anything.

Sandra Watkins, Riverstone's New Home Guide with RE/MAX Town & Country, specializes in lots, land and new construction. She and Jamey Cagle, who founded Riverstone in 1997, will walk the property with you, see what it takes to build there, and price a home on it, so the number you plan on is the land plus the house.
Found a lot on your own, or already under contract? Send it over anyway. We're happy to take a look.
